sources.text: Power section: U1 regulator output is +3V3. Input supply is VIN at connector J1 pin 1.
Connector J2 pin 4 is GND. Connector J2 pin 5 is SDA for the I2C bus.
The controller clock source is a 16 MHz crystal connected to pins XTAL_IN and XTAL_OUT.
Reset input RESET_N is active low and has a 10 kOhm pull-up to +3V3.

notes.title: Input supply connector
notes.body: VIN enters at connector J1 pin 1.

notes.title: Controller crystal
notes.body: A 16 MHz crystal connects XTAL_IN and XTAL_OUT.

notes.title: Reset pull-up resistor
notes.body: A 10 kOhm resistor pulls RESET_N up to +3V3.
